description:
Blue Sky Plan is open with a patient CBCT scan loaded (mandible_case.bsp). The panoramic curve is already set, but no surfaces have been generated yet.

Your goal is to create a manufacturing-ready 3D model of the mandible.

Instructions:
1. Go to the 'Model Editing' or 'Surface' module.
2. Generate a 3D surface for the mandible (bone density). Ensure the surface is clean.
3. Convert the open surface shell into a solid model by adding a base (use the 'Add Base' or 'Close Model' tool).
4. Emboss the text 'CASE-992' onto the model. The text must be clearly visible on the bone surface or the base.
5. Export the final model as an STL file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\printable_mandible.stl'.
